notifications.title: CLEAVE v3.2.4.3 is available
notifications.message: New: Reconcile can replace a column's value in the Main Status sheet with another column (not just add columns); Merge lets you pick a different header source per output sheet even when files are synced; and the UI wording is unified across tools. Update for the latest.

notifications.title: What's new in CLEAVE v3.2.4.3
notifications.message: Reconcile's Extra Output Information can now replace an existing compared column's value in the Main Status sheet with a chosen source column (Reconcile Detail and Diff Report keep the original). Merge lets you choose a different header source per output sheet even when "Sync same file across sheets" is on — e.g. sheet 1 from workbook A, sheet 2 from workbook B — via a new "Sync header source" sub-toggle (off by default). Wording and casing are unified across all tools.
